read_commands.command: /bin/zsh -lc "pwd; rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'pyproject.toml' -g 'setup.cfg' -g 'setup.py' -g 'CHANGES*' -g 'README*' -g '*architecture*' -g 'SKILL.md' -g 'assessment-framework.md' -g 'quality-attributes.md' -g 'technology-context.md' -g 'decision-record.md'"

/bin/zsh -lc 'cat .agents/skills/evolve-software-architecture/SKILL.md .agents/skills/evolve-software-architecture/references/technology-context.md .agents/skills/evolve-software-architecture/references/core/assessment-framework.md .agents/skills/evolve-software-architecture/references/core/quality-attributes.md .agents/skills/evolve-software-architecture/references/core/decision-record.md'

/bin/zsh -lc 'for p in /AGENTS.md /private/AGENTS.md /private/var/AGENTS.md /evaluation-path /evaluation-path /evaluation-path /evaluation-path /evaluation-path/AGENTS.md; do if test -f "$p"; then cat "$p"; fi; done'
/bin/zsh -lc 'cat pyproject.toml README.md'
/bin/zsh -lc "rg --files --hidden -g '"'!'"\\.git/**' -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'CLAUDE.md' -g '*CONTRIBUT*' -g '*tox*' -g '*pytest*' -g '.github/**' -g 'src/**' -g 'tests/**' -g 'docs/**'"
/bin/zsh -lc 'git status --short; git log -10 --oneline; git describe --tags --always; git remote -v'
/bin/zsh -lc 'cat src/click/__init__.py docs/api.rst docs/testing.rst docs/exceptions.rst tox.ini .github/workflows/tests.yaml tests/conftest.py tests/test_imports.py'

/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n '"'^class |''^    def (main|invoke|make_context|parse_args|resolve_command|process_value|handle_parse_result|close|__call__|scope|isolation|get_result|__exit__|call_on_close|with_resource)|''^def |standalone_mode|sys'"\\.(exit|argv|stdin|stdout|stderr)|get_current_context|push_context|pop_context' src/click/core.py src/click/testing.py src/click/globals.py src/click/decorators.py"

/bin/zsh -lc "cat CONTRIBUTING.rst; git log -25 --oneline -- src/click/core.py src/click/testing.py src/click/__init__.py tests/test_testing.py; sed -n '1,220p' CHANGES.rst; rg -n 'subclass|Command|MultiCommand|invoke|context|thread|standalone|forward|exit|result_callback' docs/commands.rst docs/advanced.rst docs/complex.rst docs/upgrading.rst tests/test_custom_classes.py tests/test_context.py tests/test_testing.py"
/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,115p' CHANGES.rst; git log -18 --oneline -- src/click/core.py src/click/testing.py; cat CONTRIBUTING.rst"

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,130p' src/click/core.py; sed -n '290,330p' src/click/core.py; sed -n '460,625p' src/click/core.py; sed -n '735,835p' src/click/core.py; sed -n '850,1140p' src/click/core.py; cat src/click/globals.py"
/bin/zsh -lc "nl -ba src/click/testing.py | sed -n '1,265p'"
/bin/zsh -lc "nl -ba src/click/testing.py | sed -n '265,590p'"
/bin/zsh -lc "nl -ba tests/test_testing.py | sed -n '1,370p'; nl -ba tests/test_context.py | sed -n '1,235p'"

/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n '"'^def test_|subprocess|CliRunner|make_context|'"\\.invoke\\(|standalone_mode|with_resource|call_on_close|_pause_echo|should_strip_ansi|FORCED_WIDTH' tests/test_commands.py tests/test_context.py tests/test_custom_classes.py tests/test_testing.py tests/test_parser.py tests/test_chain.py; git show --stat fdc6b02; git show fdc6b02 -- tests/test_testing.py; git show ffd43e9 -- src/click/testing.py"

/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n '"'^class |''^    def (make_parser|parse_args|invoke|resolve_command|process_value|consume_value|handle_parse_result|exit|__call__)'"' src/click/core.py; nl -ba src/click/core.py | sed -n '1140,1165p'; nl -ba src/click/core.py | sed -n '1390,1455p'; nl -ba src/click/core.py | sed -n '1585,1635p'; nl -ba src/click/core.py | sed -n '1660,1755p'"

/bin/zsh -lc "nl -ba src/click/decorators.py | sed -n '150,255p'; nl -ba src/click/core.py | sed -n '2350,2430p'; nl -ba tests/test_commands.py | sed -n '532,548p'; nl -ba tests/test_context.py | sed -n '238,255p'; rg -n 'subprocess|Popen|check_output|check_call|\\.run\\(' tests; rg -n 'should_strip_ansi|visible_prompt_func|hidden_prompt_func|_getchar|FORCED_WIDTH|_local' src/click/{_compat,utils,termui,formatting,testing,globals}.py"

/bin/zsh -lc "nl -ba src/click/core.py | sed -n '470,489p'; nl -ba src/click/core.py | sed -n '535,610p'; nl -ba src/click/core.py | sed -n '680,711p'; nl -ba src/click/core.py | sed -n '1060,1126p'; nl -ba src/click/__init__.py | sed -n '1,24p'; nl -ba docs/exceptions.rst | sed -n '30,64p'"

/bin/zsh -lc "nl -ba src/click/core.py | sed -n '495,524p'; nl -ba src/click/core.py | sed -n '911,952p'; nl -ba src/click/core.py | sed -n '2268,2298p'; nl -ba tests/test_custom_classes.py | sed -n '1,118p'; nl -ba tests/test_commands.py | sed -n '148,181p'; nl -ba tests/test_imports.py | sed -n '54,72p'; nl -ba docs/testing.rst | sed -n '1,25p'; nl -ba pyproject.toml | sed -n '1,24p'; nl -ba tox.ini | sed -n '1,59p'"

/bin/zsh -lc "git diff --stat; git status --short; git log -6 --oneline -- docs/exceptions.rst; git show --stat 422e211; git show --stat d83868a; rg -n 'isolation|_compat|should_strip|FORCED_WIDTH|close.*(error|exception)|cleanup.*(error|exception)|LookupError|charset|encoding' tests/test_testing.py tests/test_context.py tests/test_commands.py tests/test_compat.py tests/test_termui.py"
